verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is itself an agent product: persistent cloud Bots that act on a computer and talk to each other. Serving tools to other agents through an MCP server is a different product role, so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the pack shows Grok Bot running as an MCP server, and a probe found no MCP endpoint, API or CLI in its docs. Marketplace connectors are client-side plugins and do not make the server axis applicable.
